question: Which of the following Indian cities is situated at the banks of Lake Pichola?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udaipur.**__​

__
 
• Pichola Lake is one of the oldest and largest lakes of Udaipur.
 
• In 1362 this lake was built by Pichu Banjara during the ruling period of Maharana Lakha.
